title: Athanor Runtime Configuration
description: JSON Schema for athanor.json — the Athanor runtime configuration file at the project root. Root is permissive (additionalProperties: true) so user installs may add unknown fields without validation errors; sub-objects with known shape are strict (additionalProperties: false) but always permit a `_doc` string sibling that acts as inline schema documentation.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference URL — release-tag-pinned per CONTRIBUTING.md §Release URL bump.

version.description: Configuration schema version (e.g. "1.0"). Not the plugin version.

_doc.description: Free-form inline documentation for the root config object.

enabled.description: Whether the Codex CLI cross-model planner is invoked when available.

fallback.description: Strategy when codex CLI is unavailable or disabled by config.

timeoutMs.description: Hard wall-clock timeout (ms) for codex exec invocations. Default 300000 (5min). Maximum 600000 (10min). Converted to seconds at dispatch and applied as shell `timeout NNNs codex …` prefix. Soft-deadline (fallbackAfterMs) requires leader-side async join, deferred to v0.16+. Lowering below ~60000 may truncate legitimate Codex planning runs.

maxRetries.description: Max ralph-loop iterations per subtask before circuit breaker engages.

consecutiveFailures.description: Threshold of consecutive subtask failures that trips the breaker.

action.description: Action taken when the circuit breaker trips.

waveSize.description: Max parallel workers per wave in team mode.

discoveryRelay.description: Whether previous wave discoveries are injected into next wave prompts.

decayDays.description: Working lesson decay window in days.

promotionThreshold.description: Access count required to auto-promote a working lesson to permanent. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED — the permanent->mem-search promotion is not wired; only frontmatter 'importance' marking + .athanor/lessons/ files exist (see docs/STATE.md Known gaps).

maxAgeDays.description: Session retention window in days before the cleaner removes them.

language.description: Slash-command trigger language. Advisory — NOT enforced at dispatch; skills declare both ko+en triggers regardless of this value.

Best-effort 사용자-대면 제시/산출물 출력 언어 선호. triggers.language(트리거 키워드 인식)와 별개 축. Advisory — 런타임이 분기 강제하지 않으며 각 스킬 leader가 Present-to-User 직전 해석한다(부재/malformed 시 en). Deterministic localization 아님. default en.

hooks.description: Stop hook configuration. As of v0.7.8, profile is honored at runtime by scripts/hooks/stop_verify_claims.py. As of v0.7.9, stopLoopThreshold caps consecutive-block loops.

profile.description: Stop hook gate mode: 'off' disables the gate (script exits 0 silently); 'standard' (default) enables full material-claim detection. Unknown values fall back to standard with a stderr warning at runtime. 'lenient' and 'strict' are not yet supported (deferred per plan §10).

stopLoopThreshold.description: v0.7.9+: Max consecutive exit-2 blocks per session before the circuit breaker opens and the (N+1)th invocation releases (exit 0). Prevents infinite gate loops when the verification skill misbehaves. Default 3 if missing. Set higher to be more strict, lower to release faster on suspected misconfiguration.

freeze.description: Freeze guard configuration (v0.18.0). Opt-in scope-locked editing for Claude file tools (Edit/Write/MultiEdit). Subprocess writes (Bash, Codex) are NOT gated (residual).

mode.description: off = no enforcement (default), session = enforce per-session allowlist, warn = log violations but allow

allowedPaths.description: User-extended allowlist; added to dynamic per-session allowlist, never replaces it

mode.description: observe = report evidence observations only; warn = preserve hybrid pass/concern/failure behavior; strict = promote evidence concerns to failures

safetyCorpus.description: Opt-in PreToolUse safety-pattern corpus diagnostics. Default off; observe/warn never block.

mode.description: off = no diagnostics, observe = write JSONL findings, warn = write JSONL findings and stderr summary. No blocking mode in this release.

lenses.description: Default lenses dispatched in parallel by /athanor:review.

personas.description: Optional persona set extending the default 6-lens dispatch. Persona prompts live as subsections in skills/review/SKILL.md.

minConfidence.description: Confidence-rubric threshold for suppressing low-signal findings during consolidation.

lfgGoal.description: Goal-oriented LFG loop configuration consumed by skills/lfg-goal/. Sub-block defines circuit-breaker thresholds, adversarial tiering, release shape, archival, and dry-run semantics for the v0.13.0 LFG-goal surface.

maxIterations.description: Maximum cycles per goal-loop invocation; circuit breaker fires when reached. Default 5 per D8.

noProgressThreshold.description: Consecutive cycles with no new diff or test count change abort the loop with a no-progress signal.

tier2Adversarial.description: Tier 2 goal-check dispatches judge-A (Claude) plus judge-B (Codex) in parallel; both must agree for the goal-check to pass.

tier3UserRatification.description: Tier 3 BLOCKING user prompt at goal-completion; cannot be disabled without an explicit flag.

scopeDriftAutoCheck.description: Auto-fire /athanor:scope-drift between cycles to guard against off-plan diffs.

consolidateCycles.description: When true, all cycles roll up into a single PR plus final release; when false (default per D9), each cycle ships its own patch release.

archiveOnComplete.description: Copy completed goal directory (goal.md + goal-completion.md) to docs/goals-completed/<id>/ (tracked) after goal-complete.

goalRetentionDays.description: Cleaner ages out completed or abandoned goals after N days.

goalsDir.description: Root directory for goal ledgers; relative to the project root. Default .athanor/goals.

scoreTarget.description: Optional score-target policy for lfg-goal loops that repeatedly run /athanor:assess and continue cycles until the assessment score reaches the declared target.

enabled.description: When true, lfg-goal runs assessment scorecards at bootstrap and after each cycle; default false.

targetOverall.description: Default overall assessment score target on a 0-100 scale when score-target mode is enabled.

targetMinDimension.description: Default minimum acceptable score for every non-waived assessment dimension.

maxAllowedRegression.description: Maximum allowed per-dimension score regression between assessment reports before completion is blocked.

dryRun.description: When true, simulate cycles without committing. Intended for development and test mode.

lfg.description: Configuration for the /athanor:lfg end-to-end pipeline. Exposes the opt-OUT (default-on) auto-merge switch for /athanor:lfg Step 8.5 (Merge-readiness gate + optional merge) and the Step 3/8 fix-round cap (maxFixRounds).

autoMerge.description: Opt-OUT (default-on) auto-merge switch for /athanor:lfg Step 8.5. When true (the default), a green PR may be merged to its base branch after the Step 8.5 conjunctive merge-readiness gate passes; the pipeline still records the outcome and never bypasses the gate. When false, the pipeline terminates at 'PR open + CI green' and never merges. The invocation flag --unmerge hard-disables the merge even when this config is true (fail-safe direction wins ties); --merge explicitly enables when this is false. Documentary/discoverability knob — the load-bearing default is true.

maxFixRounds.description: Cap (default 3) on the /athanor:lfg Step 3 (review-fix) and Step 8 (CI-fix) fix-round loops, surfaced by scripts/loops/lfg_fix_round_counter.py. The leader runs `bump --loop review|ci` each round and treats exit 3 (count reaches/exceeds this cap) as 'stop iterating'. Honesty label: ADVISORY (leader-bound exit-code) — a real exit code now exists (a strict upgrade over pure prose), but no PreToolUse/Stop runtime hook forces the leader to branch (same enforcement class as the Step 8.5 merge-readiness gate). NOT enforced.
